props.covers: The durable campaign and series shapes, status semantics, and review-work transition rules.

text.insert: PrCampaignState is the durable HarnessState slice for one review campaign cut from an immutable source anchor. PrSeriesState carries each local branch, upstream identity, validation result, blockers, and deduplicated feedback work.

props.description: Durable campaign owning the series split from one stable point and the activations that work them.

fields.name: source_anchor
fields.description: The stable point the campaign was split from. Immutable — sync invalidations arrive as blockers, never by rewriting the anchor.

fields.name: publication_policy
fields.description: Publication is operator-gated per batch; preparing more series never opens them.

fields.name: batch_size
fields.description: Series opened per operator-approved batch so reviewers are not swamped.

fields.name: series_ids
fields.description: Every series in the campaign, published or not, in batch order.

fields.name: activation_ids
fields.description: Lease-holding activations; each is mirrored as a pr_phase entry in the cycle timeline.

fields.name: closed_at
fields.description: Absent while the campaign remains open and present only after completed or abandoned becomes terminal.

props.name: PrCampaignState

props.description: One reviewable PR: branch, upstream identity, feedback work items, and validation evidence.

fields.name: campaign_id
fields.description: Links the series to its containing campaign.

fields.name: batch_index
fields.description: Publication batch this series belongs to; batches open in order, each on explicit operator go.

fields.name: upstream_pr_number
fields.description: Absent until the series is published.

fields.name: target_units
fields.description: Primary translation units motivating the series; cross-module edits are allowed when they serve these targets.

fields.name: work_items
fields.description: Durable feedback items; ingestion is background-safe and never waits for the lease.

fields.name: source_kind
fields.description: Identifies the kind of feedback origin mapped by this durable work item.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Identifies the feedback origin within source_kind.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The exact work-item status vocabulary. declined is terminal and means deliberately not actioned with a recorded reason.

fields.name: last_validation
fields.description: Most recent gate validation of the series branch.

props.name: PrSeriesState

text.insert: The campaign source_anchor never moves; later upstream movement adds invalidation evidence or blockers. upstream_pr_number is absent before publication, and closed_at is present only for completed or abandoned campaigns.

props.title: Campaign status semantics
rows: The anchored campaign and prepared series are assembled locally.
An activation is publishing, fixing, or validating series.
The campaign holds the dispatch lease.
At least one series is open and no activation holds the lease.
Only observation and feedback ingestion advance state.
Every series is terminal and closure is confirmed.
The operator ends the campaign with remaining work.

props.title: Series status semantics
rows: Locally cut and gate-validated; not open upstream.
Open upstream and waiting for review.
Remote feedback exists as pending work.
Fixers own feedback work and may mutate the branch.
Remote review approved; merge is pending.

props.title: PR work-item status semantics
rows: A lease-fenced fixer owns the item.
Addressed by a pushed revision or review-thread answer.
Deliberately not actioned with a recorded reason.

steps.text: Cut the anchored campaign and prepare ordered series
Publish an approved batch, repair feedback, or validate series
Background observation advances remote state and creates pending work items
Resolve or decline every in-progress item before release
Record merged or closed series and confirm campaign completion or abandonment

text.insert: Compatibility: pr.adopt_legacy deterministically creates the anchored campaign and imports pre-campaign branch order, upstream identities, validation, outcomes, and feedback. Retrying returns the same campaign instead of duplicating state.
